collection: Mochi Bedtime Stories: Japan — 100 Cozy Tales from the Land of the Rising Sun
languageNote: Japanese (kana/kanji written form + romaji + English gloss on first use). Sprinkled naturally: konnichiwa, arigatou, oishii (delicious), kawaii (cute), ganbatte (do your best), itadakimasu, ohayou, oyasumi (goodnight), sugoi (amazing), genki (lively/well), daijoubu (it's okay), yokatta (thank goodness). 3-5 Japanese terms per story; the Spotlight term is the headline vocabulary word.

newCharacters.name: Momo Mochi
newCharacters.appearance: A soft, pillowy snow-white rice cake dusted with potato starch, plump and squishable, with rosy peach cheeks (momo means peach) and arms that stretch like warm taffy for hugs. A faint dimple where the sweet filling hides.
newCharacters.voice: Warm, bouncy, endlessly affectionate; uses gentle exclamations and loves a group squish. The cozy heart of the cast.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Squish together, stay together!

newCharacters.name: Niko Nigiri
newCharacters.appearance: A tidy oval pillow of pearly white rice wearing a glossy coral-orange salmon cape, bound by a neat little nori belt. Stands very straight and proud, with bright attentive eyes.
newCharacters.voice: Polite, organized, a planner who loves doing things 'the right way' but learns to roll with surprises. Slightly formal, very kind.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Let's do this neatly... or deliciously!

newCharacters.name: Tama Onigiri
newCharacters.appearance: A plump triangle of warm white rice with a single crisp black nori band like a sash, a tiny pickled-plum blush on one cheek. Comfy and round-shouldered, like a little backpack of comfort.
newCharacters.voice: Reliable, snacky, the friend who always packs extra for everyone. Gentle humor, a bit motherly-cozy in a kid-sized way.
newCharacters.catchphrase: I packed a little extra, just in case!

newCharacters.name: Rin Ramen
newCharacters.appearance: A steaming ceramic bowl on stubby legs, golden broth swirling, with noodle-curl 'hair', a soft-boiled egg cheek, a corn freckle, and a nori name-tag. Always faintly steaming when excited.
newCharacters.voice: Hearty, big-feelings, slurpy laugh; warm and a touch dramatic about flavor. The 'let's all eat and feel better' friend.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Everything's better warm and bubbly!

newCharacters.name: Tako & Yaki
newCharacters.appearance: A giggly pair of round golden batter-balls connected by a wobbly bonito-flake wave on top, drizzled with sauce zig-zags. Bounce in unison and finish each other's sentences.
newCharacters.voice: Twin-energy, fast and playful, talk over each other and high-five constantly. Mischief that's always sweet.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Roll us once — we come as two!

newCharacters.name: Tai Taiyaki
newCharacters.appearance: A cheerful golden fish-shaped waffle-cake with a crispy fin-tail and a warm red-bean heart you can see when he smiles wide. Swims through air with a little waddle.
newCharacters.voice: Adventurous, splashy optimism, loves the sea and 'swimming' even on dry land. Brave and bubbly.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Swim toward the sweet stuff!

newCharacters.name: Maru Matcha
newCharacters.food: matcha (whisked green tea) with a matcha-cream swirl head
newCharacters.appearance: A small jade-green bowl-headed friend with a frothy matcha-cream swirl on top like soft-serve hair, calm half-moon eyes, and a tiny bamboo whisk she carries like a wand.
newCharacters.voice: Calm, thoughtful, gently funny in a deadpan way; the steady one who helps everyone breathe. Speaks in cozy little proverbs.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Whisk slow. Feel calm.

newCharacters.name: Dai Daruma
newCharacters.appearance: A round, roly-poly crimson dome-shaped bun with big determined eyebrows and one painted eye (the other waiting for a wish). Wobbles but always rights himself.
newCharacters.voice: Stubbornly encouraging coach-voice, full of pep and 'never give up' energy; lovably bossy about courage.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Fall down seven, bounce up eight!

newCharacters.name: Mero Melonpan
newCharacters.appearance: A puffy domed bun with a crackly golden-green cross-hatched crust, fluffy and sweet, with sleepy happy eyes and crumbs that sparkle. A bit of a dreamer who naps anywhere.
newCharacters.voice: Soft, sleepy, sweet; speaks like he's half-dreaming and finds wonder in tiny things. Cozy and slow.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Crackle on the outside, dreams on the inside.

newCharacters.name: The Dango Three (Pinku, Shiro, Cha)
newCharacters.food: hanami dango (pink, white, green skewered dumplings)
newCharacters.appearance: Three little round dumplings on one stick — Pinku (pink, bold), Shiro (white, shy), Cha (green/matcha, clever) — who travel everywhere together and pivot like a tiny carousel.
newCharacters.voice: A bickering-but-loving trio; Pinku leads, Shiro worries, Cha solves. Together they finish a thought in three pieces.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Three on a stick, stuck together for good!

newCharacters.name: Kori Kakigori
newCharacters.appearance: A towering fluffy mountain of shaved ice drizzled with ruby strawberry syrup and a condensed-milk swirl, sunglasses perched on top, perpetually one degree from melting and loving it.
newCharacters.voice: Flamboyant, dramatic summer-diva energy; everything is the COOLEST or a total meltdown. Big-hearted under the drama.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Stay cool, sweeties — but not TOO cool!

newCharacters.name: Pock Ramune
newCharacters.appearance: A frosty pale-blue glass bottle with the famous marble in the neck, fizzy bubbles for freckles, and a 'pop!' grin. Zips around leaving a trail of happy bubbles.
newCharacters.voice: Zippy, giggly, can't sit still; punctuates sentences with a 'pop!' Excitable and friendly.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Pop the marble — let the fun fizz out!

newCharacters.name: Dora the Dorayaki
newCharacters.appearance: Two fluffy honey-brown pancakes hugging a sweet red-bean smile, soft and round, with a comfy beret. Loves stories, gadgets, and snacks (a gentle nod to a certain robot cat's favorite treat).
newCharacters.voice: Cozy storyteller, curious about everything, collects little facts and shares them warmly. Gentle wonder.
newCharacters.catchphrase: A good story is the best filling.

newCharacters.name: Neko-Pan (Maneki Melon Cream)
newCharacters.appearance: A cream-filled bun shaped like a beckoning lucky cat, one paw raised, gold-foil collar bell, and a sweet custard heart. Brings little bits of luck wherever it waves.
newCharacters.voice: Cheerful, lucky-go-happy, waves hello to everyone; believes everyone deserves a lucky day.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Wave for luck, share the luck!

newCharacters.name: Yuki the Snow Monkey-Manju
newCharacters.appearance: A fluffy white steamed bun shaped like a baby snow monkey with rosy onsen-warmed cheeks, who adores hot springs and curling up in steam.
newCharacters.voice: Snuggly, sleepy-warm, loves a soak and a nap; a tiny bit cheeky like a real monkey. Cozy mischief.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Warm cheeks, warm heart, warm friends.

newCharacters.name: Kuma the Kuri (Chestnut)
newCharacters.appearance: A glossy mahogany chestnut with a fuzzy little cap, autumn-leaf scarf, and a cozy roasted-warm glow. Round and sturdy like a tiny brave acorn-knight.
newCharacters.voice: Soft-spoken, brave in quiet ways, loves autumn and cozy fires. The shy hero who steps up when needed.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Small and roasty, ready and toasty.

newCharacters.name: Coro the Korokke
newCharacters.appearance: A crispy golden-breaded oval, fluffy mashed-potato fluff inside, a little steam puff when nervous. Soft, humble, and warm.
newCharacters.voice: Humble, kind, easily flustered but big-hearted; the everyday hero who just wants everyone fed and happy.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Crispy outside, soft heart inside.

newCharacters.name: Pepper-kun (Pepper Lunch sizzle)
newCharacters.food: Pepper Lunch sizzling beef-and-rice on a hot iron plate
newCharacters.appearance: A little round black iron hot-plate friend piled with sizzling beef strips, golden corn, butter-melt swirl and a ring of rice, sizzling happily with tiny sparks of steam. Wears a chef's bandana.
newCharacters.voice: Energetic griddle-master, loves a dramatic SIZZLE, counts down the cook like a showman. Warm and a little theatrical.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Stir it, sizzle it, share it!

newCharacters.name: Gacha the Gachapon
newCharacters.food: gachapon capsule-toy capsule (a treat-capsule full of tiny mochi prizes)
newCharacters.appearance: A glossy two-tone capsule with a surprise-filled grin, rolls like a marble, pops open to reveal tiny mochi treasures. Always full of mystery.
newCharacters.voice: Suspenseful-giddy, loves surprises and 'you never know what you'll get!', a gentle gambler of joy.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Give it a turn — surprise inside!

newCharacters.name: Sora the Soft-Cream (Hokkaido Soft Serve)
newCharacters.appearance: A tall swirl of creamy pale-gold soft-serve in a crisp cone, gentle sleepy eyes, a little drip-curl. Pure dairy comfort, calm as a snowfield.
newCharacters.voice: Gentle, dreamy, a little melty-soft; the calm Hokkaido friend who loves wide skies and slow days.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Soft swirls, slow smiles.

newCharacters.name: Kei the kei-truck
newCharacters.food: (vehicle friend) a tiny cheerful Japanese kei-truck the food characters drive
newCharacters.appearance: A teeny, round, butter-yellow Japanese mini-truck with big headlight eyes, a stubby flatbed, and tidy little mud-flaps. Hums happily, bounces on its springs, and wears a knitted seat-cover like a sweater.
newCharacters.voice: Eager, putt-putt cheerful, loyal little engine that could. Beeps when excited.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Putt-putt, let's GO!

newCharacters.name: The Sushi-ya Express
newCharacters.food: a sushi food truck (mobile sushi counter)
newCharacters.appearance: A gleaming white-and-indigo food truck with a noren curtain, a tiny rooftop fish-flag, glowing paper-lantern headlights, and a fold-down counter that beams warm light. Smells of vinegared rice and sea breeze.
newCharacters.voice: Warm, welcoming, proud host on wheels. Rings a little bell to call friends over.
newCharacters.catchphrase: Fresh sushi, anywhere the road goes!

stories.title: Momo Mochi and the Tokyo Tower Lights
stories.setting: Tokyo, beneath the glowing orange Tokyo Tower at dusk
stories.theme: A new friend can light up a whole city for you
stories.premise: Newly arrived in the big city, squishy Momo Mochi gets gently lost and follows the warm orange glow of Tokyo Tower, meeting kind food-friends who help her find her way and her first hellos.

stories.title: Niko Nigiri and the Shibuya Scramble
stories.setting: The famous Shibuya Crossing in Tokyo at night, neon everywhere
stories.theme: Even the most organized plan needs room to wiggle
stories.premise: Tidy planner Niko Nigiri tries to cross the busiest crossing in the world with a perfect 12-step plan, but learns from his friends that sometimes you just hold hands and go with the flow.

stories.title: Pock Ramune and the Vending Machine Mystery
stories.setting: A glowing row of Tokyo street vending machines after dark
stories.theme: Curiosity is wonderful when you share what you find
stories.premise: Fizzy Pock Ramune discovers a vending machine that dispenses one mysterious warm can every midnight, and gathers friends to gently solve the cozy little secret of who keeps refilling it.

stories.title: Sora Soft-Cream at the Tokyo Skytree
stories.setting: The observation deck atop Tokyo Skytree, clouds drifting below
stories.theme: Looking down from high up makes worries feel small
stories.premise: Gentle Sora is nervous about heights until friends ride the glass elevator up Skytree with her, where she discovers the whole twinkling city looks like a cozy bowl of stars.

stories.title: The Dango Three and the Rainbow Train Lines
stories.setting: The colorful Tokyo subway map and station platforms
stories.theme: Three heads (and three colors) are better than one
stories.premise: The skewered Dango Three each want a different colored train line, so they invent a fair plan to ride all three and discover the whole rainbow loops back home.

stories.title: Rin Ramen and the Midnight Yokocho
stories.setting: A cozy lantern-lit Tokyo alleyway (yokocho) of tiny food stalls
stories.theme: A warm bowl shared makes any night feel like home
stories.premise: Steamy Rin Ramen wants to find the very best stall in a tiny lantern-lit alley, but learns the secret ingredient is simply sharing a warm bowl with new friends.

stories.title: Neko-Pan and the Akihabara Glow
stories.setting: The bright electric streets of Akihabara, Tokyo
stories.theme: Sharing your luck multiplies it
stories.premise: Lucky cat-bun Neko-Pan wanders dazzling Akihabara waving hello to everyone, spreading tiny bits of good luck until the whole street glows a little brighter.

stories.title: Momo Mochi and the Kotatsu Club
stories.setting: A snug Tokyo apartment with a warm kotatsu table in winter
stories.theme: The coziest adventures happen close to home
stories.premise: On a cold night, Momo Mochi invites the whole cast under one toasty kotatsu, but when the heat 'goes out' they discover snuggling close keeps everyone warm anyway.

stories.title: Gacha and the Capsule-Toy Arcade
stories.setting: A wall of gachapon capsule machines in a Tokyo arcade
stories.theme: The surprise you get is sometimes better than the one you wanted
stories.premise: Gacha rolls down a whole arcade of capsule machines hoping for a rare prize, but discovers the very best surprise is the friends who roll alongside him.
stories.arc: Arc 2 — Anime, Otaku and Gachapon Fun

stories.title: Dora Dorayaki and the Cozy Comic Convention
stories.setting: A friendly anime fan convention hall full of costumes and booths
stories.theme: Loving something is more fun when you find your people
stories.premise: Story-loving Dora attends his first cozy convention, feels shy about his favorite hobby, then discovers a whole warm crowd who love the very same gentle comics.
stories.arc: Arc 2 — Anime, Otaku and Gachapon Fun

stories.title: Maru Matcha and the Quiet Manga Café
stories.setting: A hushed, cozy manga café with shelves to the ceiling
stories.theme: Quiet places hold loud-bright imaginations
stories.premise: Calm Maru Matcha helps a nervous friend find the perfect first manga in a towering quiet café, learning that everyone's story-shelf is different and that's the magic.
stories.arc: Arc 2 — Anime, Otaku and Gachapon Fun

stories.title: Tako and Yaki and the Cosplay Mix-Up
stories.setting: A playful cosplay dress-up corner at a fan festival
stories.theme: Being yourself is the best costume of all
stories.premise: The takoyaki twins swap costumes to trick their friends, but the gentle giggly mix-up teaches everyone that you can dress up as anyone and still be wonderfully you.
stories.arc: Arc 2 — Anime, Otaku and Gachapon Fun

stories.title: Neko-Pan and the Cat Café Afternoon
stories.setting: A sun-warm cat café full of sleepy purring cats
stories.theme: Gentleness earns the softest trust
stories.premise: Lucky cat-bun Neko-Pan visits a cat café and learns that the shyest, fluffiest cat just needs slow, gentle patience to come out for a cuddle.
stories.arc: Arc 2 — Anime, Otaku and Gachapon Fun

stories.title: Gacha and the Claw-Machine Rescue
stories.setting: A jingling Tokyo crane-game (UFO catcher) arcade
stories.theme: Teamwork lifts what one alone cannot
stories.premise: A tiny plush friend is stuck deep in a claw machine, so Gacha rallies the cast to cheer, strategize, and gently win their friend free — together.
stories.arc: Arc 2 — Anime, Otaku and Gachapon Fun

stories.title: Dora Dorayaki and the Robot-Cat Pen Pal
stories.setting: A cozy stationery and gadget shop full of curious gizmos
stories.theme: Kindness travels farther than any gadget
stories.premise: Dora finds a friendly toy robot-cat who collects letters for lonely friends, and helps deliver warm notes across the neighborhood, snack by snack.
stories.arc: Arc 2 — Anime, Otaku and Gachapon Fun

stories.title: Yuki Snow-Monkey and the Steamy Onsen
stories.setting: A snowy mountain hot spring where real snow monkeys bathe
stories.theme: Rest is not lazy — it makes your heart stronger
stories.premise: Snuggly Yuki leads friends to a snowy hot spring, where they soak beside gentle snow monkeys and learn the cozy art of a good warm rest.

stories.title: Maru Matcha and the Snow-Monkey Friends
stories.setting: The Jigokudani snow monkey valley in winter
stories.theme: Patience opens the door to wild friendships
stories.premise: Calm Maru Matcha sits very still and whisks warm tea until a shy little snow monkey works up the courage to share the warm steam and become a friend.

stories.title: Yuki and the Towel-on-the-Head Trick
stories.setting: A traditional outdoor rotenburo bath under falling snow
stories.theme: Little traditions make ordinary moments magic
stories.premise: Yuki teaches friends the cozy onsen custom of folding a tiny towel atop your head, and a silly towel-balancing contest turns into the warmest giggle of the winter.

stories.title: Sora Soft-Cream and the Lake That Held Mount Fuji
stories.mainCharacter: Sora the Soft-Cream — a tall, swirly, pale-vanilla soft-serve cone with a gentle wobble, dreamy and thoughtful
stories.setting: The calm shore of Lake Kawaguchi with Mount Fuji reflected in the water
stories.theme: Sometimes the best view is the one reflected back
stories.premise: Sora is sad she's too short and swirly to climb tall Mount Fuji like the big kids — until the glass-calm lake shows the whole mountain upside-down at her feet, and she learns there's more than one beautiful way to see something grand.

stories.title: Dai Daruma and the Mountain of Never-Give-Up
stories.setting: A misty mountain trail with a little shrine at the top
stories.theme: Falling down is just practice for getting up
stories.premise: Roly-poly Dai Daruma keeps tumbling down a steep mountain path but bounces right back up each time, cheering his tired friends all the way to the summit shrine.

stories.title: Kuma Kuri and the Mountain Hot-Spring Eggs
stories.setting: A volcanic valley where eggs cook in the steamy spring water
stories.theme: Quiet helpers make the warmest difference
stories.premise: Shy chestnut Kuma discovers a spring hot enough to gently cook eggs and quietly prepares a steaming snack for every weary mountain traveler who passes by.

stories.title: Momo Mochi and the Foggy Ropeway
stories.setting: A mountain cable-car ropeway gliding above a sea of clouds
stories.theme: Holding hands turns fear into wonder
stories.premise: When fog swallows the mountain ropeway, squishy Momo Mochi keeps everyone calm with a hand-squeeze chain until the clouds part to reveal a breathtaking view.

stories.title: Maru Matcha and the First Torii Gate
stories.setting: A quiet forest shrine with a single vermilion torii gate
stories.theme: Some doorways are for slowing down and saying thanks
stories.premise: Calm Maru Matcha teaches her friends the gentle custom of bowing at a torii gate, and the quiet little ritual makes the whole shrine feel softly special.

stories.title: Niko Nigiri and the Thousand Red Gates
stories.setting: The endless tunnel of vermilion torii gates at Fushimi Inari, Kyoto
stories.theme: You don't need to see the end to enjoy the path
stories.premise: Organized Niko wants to count all thousand red gates at once, but learns to enjoy each glowing gate as it comes, one cozy step at a time.

stories.title: Dai Daruma and the Wishing Eye
stories.setting: A shrine stall selling lucky daruma dolls
stories.theme: A wish is a promise you make to yourself
stories.premise: Dai Daruma helps a worried friend pick a real daruma doll and paint its first eye, learning that a wish works best when you try your hardest to make it come true.

stories.title: Neko-Pan and the Maneki-Neko Shrine
stories.setting: Gotokuji Temple, famous for hundreds of beckoning cat statues
stories.theme: A small kindness can fill a whole temple
stories.premise: At a temple covered in hundreds of beckoning-cat statues, Neko-Pan returns a lost lucky charm to its owner and the whole grateful row of cats seems to wave.

stories.title: Tama Onigiri and the Festival Fox Mask
stories.setting: A summer night matsuri with food stalls and lantern stands
stories.theme: Sharing a snack turns strangers into friends
stories.premise: At a bustling summer festival, comforting Tama Onigiri shares packed rice balls with a shy friend hiding behind a cute fox mask, and helps them find the courage to play.

stories.title: Pock Ramune and the Festival Goldfish Scoop
stories.setting: A festival goldfish-scooping (kingyo-sukui) game stall
stories.theme: Gentle hands win more than grabby ones
stories.premise: Fizzy Pock Ramune learns that the festival goldfish game rewards a soft, patient scoop, and he gently helps a smaller friend win their very first goldfish.

stories.title: The Dango Three and the Portable-Shrine Parade
stories.setting: A festival street parade carrying a mikoshi portable shrine
stories.theme: Everyone carries a little of the load
stories.premise: The three dango each grab a corner of a tiny portable shrine and learn that a heavy, joyful load becomes light when shouldered together with a happy chant.

stories.title: Rin Ramen and the Lucky Omikuji
stories.setting: A shrine where you draw paper fortunes (omikuji)
stories.theme: You make your own good fortune by being kind
stories.premise: When Rin Ramen draws a so-so fortune at the shrine, his friends show him that a warm bowl shared makes any day a 'great blessing' no matter what the paper says.

stories.title: Anko and the Sharing Bench
stories.mainCharacter: Anko — a round, soft, sweet red-bean bun with a shiny top and a generous heart
stories.setting: A sunny park bench by a koi pond
stories.theme: A snack shared is a snack doubled
stories.premise: Anko the red-bean bun saves the comfiest park bench all for himself and his snack, then slowly discovers that every friend he scoots over to make room for makes the bench cozier and the afternoon sweeter.
stories.arc: Arc 5 — Four Seasons: Hanami and Hanabi

stories.title: Momo Mochi and the Pink Petal Snow
stories.setting: A hilltop park during a swirling cherry-blossom snowfall
stories.theme: Catching a little joy is better than chasing all of it
stories.premise: Squishy Momo Mochi tries to catch every falling petal, then realizes the magic is just lying back with friends and letting the pink snow land where it likes.
stories.arc: Arc 5 — Four Seasons: Hanami and Hanabi

stories.title: Kori Kakigori and the Summer Meltdown
stories.setting: A blazing-hot summer beach boardwalk
stories.theme: Friends help you keep your cool
stories.premise: Dramatic shaved-ice Kori is convinced she'll melt away on the hottest day of summer, until her friends build a shady fort and keep her sweet and frosty.
stories.arc: Arc 5 — Four Seasons: Hanami and Hanabi

stories.title: Tako and Yaki and the Summer Fireworks
stories.setting: A riverside hanabi fireworks festival on a summer night
stories.theme: The best moments are even better doubled with someone you love
stories.premise: The takoyaki twins each want to watch the fireworks from a different spot, then discover that the show is twice as sparkly when they 'ooh' and 'aah' side by side.
stories.arc: Arc 5 — Four Seasons: Hanami and Hanabi

stories.title: Kuma Kuri and the Autumn Leaf Trail
stories.setting: A mountain temple path blazing with red and gold autumn leaves
stories.theme: Change can be the most beautiful thing of all
stories.premise: Chestnut Kuma feels sad that summer is ending, but a walk through fiery red momiji leaves teaches him that autumn has a cozy, crackly magic all its own.
stories.arc: Arc 5 — Four Seasons: Hanami and Hanabi

stories.title: Yuki and the First Snowfall
stories.setting: A quiet village square under the season's first snow
stories.theme: Wonder is for sharing
stories.premise: Snow-loving Yuki wakes everyone for the first snowfall of winter, and the whole sleepy cast tumbles out to make tiny snow-friends in the hush of the white morning.
stories.arc: Arc 5 — Four Seasons: Hanami and Hanabi

stories.title: Maru Matcha and the Carp Streamers
stories.setting: A spring sky filled with koinobori carp-shaped windsocks
stories.theme: Swim bravely against the wind and you'll grow strong
stories.premise: Maru Matcha helps a shy little friend raise a carp streamer for the first time, and they watch it swim bravely up the spring wind like a wish taking flight.
stories.arc: Arc 5 — Four Seasons: Hanami and Hanabi

stories.title: Sora Soft-Cream and the Winter Illuminations
stories.setting: A park glittering with millions of winter lights
stories.theme: Cold nights can hold the warmest glow
stories.premise: Gentle Sora bundles up against the cold to wander a sparkling winter light festival, learning that the chilliest night can shine the brightest with friends near.
stories.arc: Arc 5 — Four Seasons: Hanami and Hanabi

stories.title: Rin Ramen and the Secret Broth Recipe
stories.setting: A steamy back-street ramen counter run by a kindly old bowl
stories.theme: The secret ingredient is always care
stories.premise: Rin Ramen begs a famous ramen master to share the legendary secret broth recipe, only to discover the real secret is the love simmered slowly into every pot.

stories.title: Pepper-kun and the Sizzling Showdown
stories.setting: A sizzling Pepper Lunch counter in a buzzing food court
stories.theme: Showing off is fun, but sharing the plate is better
stories.premise: Showman Pepper-kun stages a dramatic sizzling-beef cook-off to be the loudest plate in the food court, then learns the crowd loves him most when he shares every bite.

stories.title: Tako and Yaki and the Osaka Takoyaki Stand
stories.setting: A lively Dotonbori street-food stall in Osaka
stories.theme: Flipping fast is easier when someone flips with you
stories.premise: The takoyaki twins run their own little stall and learn to flip a tray of sizzling batter balls in perfect twin-time, turning chaos into a delicious dance.

stories.title: Tai Taiyaki and the Riverside Stall
stories.setting: A canal-side taiyaki stall where the little fish cakes are made
stories.theme: Be brave enough to swim toward your dream
stories.premise: Adventurous Tai Taiyaki dreams of 'swimming' in a real river, and his friends help him take a gentle, splashy dip before he proudly returns warm and sweet.

stories.title: Coro Korokke and the Bakery Rush
stories.setting: A busy corner bakery and deli at the morning rush
stories.theme: Helping quietly is its own kind of heroism
stories.premise: Humble Coro Korokke saves the morning rush at a frazzled bakery by calmly organizing the crispy snacks and warm bread, proving small helpers matter most.

stories.title: Mero Melonpan and the Sleepy Bakery Dream
stories.setting: A warm-smelling neighborhood bakery at closing time
stories.theme: Rest helps your imagination rise like dough
stories.premise: Dreamy Mero Melonpan dozes off in a cozy bakery and his friends gently follow his sleepy daydream of a kingdom made of warm, crackly sweet bread.

stories.title: Tama Tamago and the Conveyor-Belt Parade
stories.mainCharacter: Tama Tamago — a sweet, golden, pillowy egg (tamago) nigiri with a little seaweed belt, gentle and easily overlooked
stories.setting: A spinning conveyor-belt sushi restaurant
stories.theme: Simple and kind never goes out of style
stories.premise: Plain little Tama Tamago feels invisible riding the sushi conveyor belt beside the flashy, fancy plates — until a tired, overwhelmed customer reaches past all the dazzle for the one simple, gentle, comforting bite, and Tama learns soft kindness is its own kind of special.

stories.title: Tama Onigiri and the Bento-Box Balance
stories.setting: A schoolyard picnic with colorful packed bento lunches
stories.theme: A little of everything makes the happiest lunch
stories.premise: Tama Onigiri helps friends pack the most balanced, colorful bento boxes and discovers that the best lunch has a little bit of everyone's favorite inside.

stories.title: Rin Ramen and the Slurpy Udon Race
stories.setting: A countryside udon noodle shop famous for thick chewy noodles
stories.theme: Slowing down lets you taste the good stuff
stories.premise: When Rin challenges friends to a fast udon-slurping race, a gentle udon elder teaches them that the chewiest, warmest noodles are best enjoyed slowly.

stories.title: Momo Mochi and the Shinkansen Departure
stories.setting: A spotless bullet-train platform as the shinkansen arrives
stories.theme: Saying goodbye to one place means hello to another
stories.premise: The whole cast boards the lightning-fast bullet train for a grand cross-country trip, and Momo Mochi calms first-trip jitters with a cozy window-seat squish.

stories.title: Sora Soft-Cream and the Hokkaido Milk Farm
stories.setting: A wide-open dairy farm in snowy Hokkaido
stories.theme: Home is wherever your gentle heart feels full
stories.premise: Soft-serve Sora visits the wide Hokkaido dairy fields where she was 'born,' and learns that the creamiest comfort comes from wide skies and slow, happy cows.

stories.title: The Grand Half-Way Festival of Friends
stories.setting: A giant summer matsuri where the whole cast reunites halfway through the journey
stories.theme: Friendship is the best kind of homecoming
stories.premise: At the halfway point of their travels, the entire cast throws a huge joyful festival to celebrate fifty stories of friendship, with food, fireworks, and a thousand lanterns.

stories.title: Tako and Yaki and the Osaka Castle Adventure
stories.setting: The grand grounds of Osaka Castle with its golden details
stories.theme: Curiosity is twice as fun with a partner
stories.premise: The takoyaki twins explore towering Osaka Castle and turn a history lesson into a giggly treasure hunt for the castle's shiniest golden dolphin.

stories.title: Kuma Kuri and the Nara Deer Bows
stories.setting: Nara Park, where polite wild deer bow for treats
stories.theme: Good manners are a language everyone understands
stories.premise: Shy Kuma Kuri meets the famous bowing deer of Nara and learns that a polite little bow back is the friendliest hello of all.

stories.title: Niko Nigiri and the Kyoto Kimono Day
stories.setting: The historic Gion district of Kyoto with traditional wooden streets
stories.theme: Dressing with care honors where you are
stories.premise: Niko Nigiri carefully tries on a beautiful kimono to stroll old Kyoto, learning that taking your time with tradition makes a day feel truly special.

stories.title: Maru Matcha and the Tea Ceremony
stories.setting: A serene Kyoto tea house with tatami mats and a tiny garden
stories.theme: Doing one thing slowly and well is a gift
stories.premise: Calm Maru Matcha hosts her very first tea ceremony for her friends, sharing the quiet, beautiful art of whisking and serving one perfect bowl of tea.

stories.title: Momo Mochi and the Yukata Summer Stroll
stories.setting: A summer evening river festival in Kyoto
stories.theme: Comfort and beauty can go hand in hand
stories.premise: Squishy Momo Mochi wears a breezy summer yukata to a riverside festival and helps a friend tie a wobbly sash, proving cozy and pretty are the perfect pair.

stories.title: Sen Senbei and the Summer Wind-Chimes
stories.mainCharacter: Sen the Senbei (a flat golden rice cracker wrapped in seaweed) — a fresh, under-used character replacing the over-used Dora Dorayaki
stories.setting: A summer wind-chime (fūrin) festival in the leafy courtyard of a Kyoto temple, hundreds of glass bells hanging from the trees
stories.theme: The small things you make and give away can comfort a stranger you will never meet
stories.premise: Plain little Sen the Senbei, sure he is too small to make anything that matters, is invited by a translucent glassblower to paint glass wind-chimes and write kind notes on their paper tails — chimes that will be taken home by anonymous strangers — and witnesses a tired dumpling-child choose his bell and smile, discovering that an anonymous handmade kindness is one of the biggest things there is.
stories.arc: Worries he is too small and plain to make anything meaningful -> shyly agrees to paint and inscribe a glass fūrin -> learns the chimes go to strangers he'll never meet, so writes the comfort he most needs himself -> makes many, each a small anonymous kindness -> watches a weary child choose his very first chime and smile in the breeze -> understands his tiny voice slipped into the big song and mattered all along.

stories.title: Kuma Kuri and the Golden Pavilion
stories.setting: Kinkaku-ji, the shimmering Golden Pavilion reflected in its pond
stories.theme: True shine comes from within
stories.premise: At the dazzling Golden Pavilion, modest Kuma feels too plain beside all the gold, until friends remind him his cozy roasted warmth is its own kind of treasure.

stories.title: Kompei and the Indigo Dye Workshop
stories.mainCharacter: Kompei the Konpeito (a tiny spiky rainbow sugar candy) — a fresh, under-used character replacing the over-used Maru Matcha
stories.setting: A small indigo-dyeing (aizome) craft studio down a cobbled Kyoto lane, with big wooden tubs of glowing indigo dye
stories.theme: A happy accident can become the most beautiful part of what you make — let go of needing things perfect and embrace the unplanned
stories.premise: Perfection-obsessed Kompei goes to an indigo-dyeing workshop wanting one flawless even-blue square, but when his clumsy hand slips and bunches the cloth, the accident blooms into a stunning unplanned star-pattern — and he learns to make 'real' instead of 'perfect,' even painting a pattern by sitting on the cloth.
stories.arc: Starts rigidly chasing one perfect even square -> astonished that indigo turns from green to blue on its own (can't be forced) -> an accidental fold creates a gorgeous unplanned pattern -> begins making happy accidents on purpose and feels proud of a 'mistake' for the first time -> falls asleep under his accidental indigo cloth, content to be beautifully imperfect.

stories.title: Dai Daruma and the Calligraphy Brush
stories.setting: A traditional calligraphy classroom with ink and rice paper
stories.theme: Your first try doesn't have to be perfect to be proud
stories.premise: Determined Dai Daruma wobbles his way through writing his first big brush-stroke character, learning that a brave, splotchy first try is something to celebrate.

stories.title: Sora Soft-Cream and the Sapporo Snow Festival
stories.setting: The Sapporo Snow Festival, full of giant snow sculptures
stories.theme: Big dreams can be built one handful at a time
stories.premise: In snowy Sapporo, gentle Sora joins friends to build a towering snow sculpture, learning that even the grandest creation starts with one small, careful scoop.

stories.title: Yuki and the Hokkaido Snow Lanterns
stories.setting: A snowy Otaru canal lined with glowing ice lanterns
stories.theme: A little light shared chases away the cold
stories.premise: Snow-loving Yuki helps light a row of little ice-and-candle lanterns along a frosty canal, turning a freezing night into a warm and glowing wonderland.

stories.title: Tako and Yaki and the Okinawa Blue Sea
stories.setting: A turquoise tropical beach in sunny Okinawa
stories.theme: Adventure is sweeter shared with your other half
stories.premise: The takoyaki twins splash into the warm blue Okinawa sea and make friends with a gentle sea turtle, learning the ocean is one big playground for two.

stories.title: Tai Taiyaki and the Okinawa Coral Reef
stories.setting: A glittering coral reef aquarium in Okinawa
stories.theme: There's a whole bright world for the brave to explore
stories.premise: Fish-cake Tai Taiyaki finally meets real fish at a giant aquarium and the dazzling reef teaches him that being a little different makes you wonderfully special.

stories.title: Pepper-kun and the Osaka Food Street
stories.setting: Osaka's neon Dotonbori food street, the 'nation's kitchen'
stories.theme: The best chefs feed everyone, not just the loudest
stories.premise: Sizzling Pepper-kun explores Osaka's famous food street and teams up with an okonomiyaki cook to feed a hungry, happy crowd late into the glowing night.

stories.title: Coro Korokke and the Hokkaido Potato Fields
stories.setting: Rolling golden potato fields under a wide Hokkaido sky
stories.theme: Knowing where you come from helps you grow
stories.premise: Humble Coro Korokke visits the wide Hokkaido potato fields where his fluffy heart began, and learns to feel proud of his simple, comforting roots.

stories.title: Niko Nigiri and the Tsukiji Morning Market
stories.setting: The bustling outer fish market at dawn in Tokyo
stories.theme: Early effort makes the freshest day
stories.premise: Niko Nigiri wakes before dawn to explore the busy morning market and learns from the kind vendors that the freshest, brightest days belong to early risers.

stories.title: Momo Mochi and the New-Year Mochi Pounding
stories.setting: A village square at New Year where mochi is pounded in a big wooden mortar
stories.theme: New beginnings are best started together
stories.premise: At the New Year mochi-pounding festival, Momo Mochi cheers as friends take turns with the big wooden mallet, celebrating fresh starts with sticky, squishy joy.
stories.arc: Arc 11 — Holidays and Seasons of the Year

stories.title: Dai Daruma and the New-Year First Shrine Visit
stories.setting: A bustling shrine on New Year's morning for the first visit (hatsumode)
stories.theme: A fresh year is a fresh chance to try
stories.spotlightTerm: あけましておめでとう
stories.premise: On the first shrine visit of the year, Dai Daruma helps friends choose hopeful New Year wishes and reminds everyone that a new year means a brand-new bounce.
stories.arc: Arc 11 — Holidays and Seasons of the Year

stories.title: Tama Onigiri and the Bean-Throwing Day
stories.setting: A home celebrating Setsubun with friendly bean-throwing
stories.theme: You can chase away worries with a giggle
stories.premise: On bean-throwing day, comforting Tama Onigiri befriends a shy, cuddly little oni who only wanted to join the fun, turning the custom into a game of welcome.
stories.arc: Arc 11 — Holidays and Seasons of the Year

stories.title: The Dango Three and the Doll Festival
stories.setting: A home decorated for Hinamatsuri, the Doll Festival, in spring
stories.theme: Everyone deserves a place on the shelf
stories.premise: The three dango help arrange the tiered doll display for the spring Doll Festival and make sure even the smallest, dustiest doll gets a place of honor.
stories.arc: Arc 11 — Holidays and Seasons of the Year

stories.title: Tai Taiyaki and the Children's Day Carp
stories.setting: A breezy hillside on Children's Day with giant carp streamers
stories.theme: Grow strong by swimming your own brave way
stories.premise: On Children's Day, fish-cake Tai Taiyaki races the giant carp streamers up the hill and learns that swimming your own brave direction is how you grow up strong.
stories.arc: Arc 11 — Holidays and Seasons of the Year

stories.title: Mero Melonpan and the Tanabata Wishes
stories.setting: A summer street strung with bamboo and colorful Tanabata wish-papers
stories.theme: A written wish is a dream you dare to share
stories.premise: Dreamy Mero Melonpan helps friends write their summer star-festival wishes on colorful papers and tie them to a bamboo branch reaching up toward the Milky Way.
stories.arc: Arc 11 — Holidays and Seasons of the Year

stories.title: Maru Matcha and the Moon-Viewing Night
stories.setting: A grassy hill on the autumn moon-viewing night (Tsukimi)
stories.theme: Quiet beauty is worth staying up a little for
stories.premise: Calm Maru Matcha gathers friends for an autumn moon-viewing picnic with round dumplings, and they spot the gentle 'rabbit' said to live on the bright full moon.
stories.arc: Arc 11 — Holidays and Seasons of the Year

stories.title: Momo Mochi and the Warm Winter-Solstice Bath
stories.setting: A cozy bathhouse on the winter solstice with floating yuzu fruit
stories.theme: Small warm rituals carry you through the cold
stories.premise: On the longest, coldest night, squishy Momo Mochi shares the cozy custom of a yuzu-citrus bath, filling the bathhouse with golden fruit and warm giggles.
stories.arc: Arc 11 — Holidays and Seasons of the Year

stories.title: Kuma Kuri and the Friendly Forest Spirit
stories.setting: A mossy forest shrine where a small, cuddly forest spirit lives
stories.theme: Kindness makes even shy spirits smile
stories.premise: Shy Kuma Kuri meets an equally shy, fluffy little forest spirit, and the two quiet friends discover that being bashful together is the start of a sweet friendship.
stories.arc: Arc 12 — Friendly Folklore and Gentle Spirits

stories.title: Maru Matcha and the Tea-Loving Tanuki
stories.setting: A countryside teahouse visited by a roly-poly tanuki
stories.theme: Sharing turns a sneaky guest into a true friend
stories.premise: A playful, pot-bellied tanuki keeps sneaking sips of Maru Matcha's tea, until she simply invites him to sit and share a proper cup, turning mischief into friendship.
stories.arc: Arc 12 — Friendly Folklore and Gentle Spirits

stories.title: Tama Onigiri and the Shy Kappa of the Pond
stories.setting: A lily-padded village pond home to a gentle little kappa
stories.theme: A small gift can melt the biggest shyness
stories.premise: Comforting Tama Onigiri leaves a tiny rice ball by the pond for a bashful, cucumber-loving kappa, and a careful, kind friendship blossoms over shared snacks.
stories.arc: Arc 12 — Friendly Folklore and Gentle Spirits

stories.title: Dora Dorayaki and the Lantern-Lighting Spirits
stories.setting: A summer Obon evening with floating paper lanterns on a river
stories.theme: Remembering someone keeps their warmth glowing
stories.premise: Story-keeper Dora helps tiny friendly spirits guide their glowing paper lanterns down a gentle river, learning that warm memories light the softest, kindest path.
stories.arc: Arc 12 — Friendly Folklore and Gentle Spirits

stories.title: Neko-Pan and the Lucky Beckoning Spirits
stories.setting: A tiny roadside shrine guarded by cheerful good-luck cat spirits
stories.theme: Luck shared is luck doubled
stories.premise: Neko-Pan meets a family of cheerful little luck-spirits who have run out of good fortune to give, and helps them refill their kindness by spreading joy all day.
stories.arc: Arc 12 — Friendly Folklore and Gentle Spirits

stories.title: Mero Melonpan and the Dream-Eating Baku
stories.setting: A cozy bedroom at night visited by a gentle dream-eating baku
stories.theme: A good friend can chase away a bad dream
stories.premise: When a friend has a worried little dream, sleepy Mero Melonpan introduces a soft, friendly baku who gently nibbles away the worry and leaves only sweet dreams.
stories.arc: Arc 12 — Friendly Folklore and Gentle Spirits

stories.title: Pock Ramune and the Summer Cicada Chorus
stories.setting: A green countryside hillside buzzing with summer cicadas
stories.theme: Every voice adds to the song
stories.premise: Fizzy Pock Ramune wants to find the loudest cicada of summer, but learns that the buzzing hillside sounds best when every little voice sings together.

stories.title: Kuma Kuri and the Rice-Paddy Fireflies
stories.setting: Terraced rice paddies glowing with summer fireflies at dusk
stories.theme: The smallest lights make the most magical night
stories.premise: Shy Kuma Kuri sits quietly by the glowing rice paddies as hundreds of gentle fireflies rise, discovering that even tiny, bashful lights can fill a whole valley.

stories.title: Sora Soft-Cream and the Lavender Fields
stories.setting: The rolling purple lavender fields of Furano, Hokkaido
stories.theme: Slow days are full of quiet color
stories.premise: Gentle Sora drifts through endless purple lavender fields and helps friends notice the soft buzzing bees, the sweet scent, and the slow joy of a sunny afternoon.

stories.title: Tama Onigiri and the Rice-Harvest Helpers
stories.setting: Golden autumn rice fields at harvest time
stories.theme: Good things come from working side by side
stories.premise: Rice-ball Tama Onigiri joins the autumn harvest and learns the long, happy journey from golden field to warm bowl, thanking every helper along the way.

stories.title: Maru Matcha and the Tea-Hill Morning
stories.setting: Misty terraced green-tea hills at sunrise in Shizuoka
stories.theme: The earliest, quietest hour holds a gentle gift
stories.premise: Calm Maru Matcha wakes at dawn to walk the misty rows of her home tea hills, sharing with friends the peaceful, dewy green hush of the very early morning.

stories.title: Tako and Yaki and the Koi Pond Friends
stories.setting: A peaceful garden koi pond with shimmering carp
stories.theme: Calm friends can balance your bouncy energy
stories.premise: The bouncy takoyaki twins befriend the slow, graceful koi of a garden pond and learn that there's a happy place between zooming around and drifting peacefully.

stories.title: Yuki and the Snow-Country Village
stories.setting: The thatched-roof snow village of Shirakawa-go in deep winter
stories.theme: A village keeps each other warm
stories.premise: Snuggly Yuki visits a storybook snow village of steep thatched roofs and learns how the whole community helps shovel, share, and stay cozy through the long winter.

stories.title: Pepper-kun and the Midnight Garage
stories.setting: A glowing late-night garage in Tokyo
stories.theme: Care and craftsmanship make anything shine
stories.premise: Sizzly Pepper-kun helps the friends gently tune up a sleepy little kei-truck in a warm neon garage, learning that the magic is in the loving details.

stories.title: Niko Nigiri and the Neon Car Meet
stories.mainCharacter: Niko Nigiri (sushi) & the Sushi-ya Express truck
stories.setting: A neon-lit parking-lot car meet at night
stories.theme: Show your own style and you'll find your crew
stories.premise: Tidy Niko parks the little Sushi-ya Express food truck at a friendly glowing car meet and discovers that everyone's ride is wonderfully different.

stories.title: The Sushi-ya Express and the Touge Sunrise
stories.setting: A winding mountain pass (touge) at dawn
stories.theme: The joy is the journey you share
stories.premise: The sushi-truck crew takes a gentle, careful dawn drive up a misty mountain pass to deliver the freshest sunrise breakfast sushi.

stories.title: Tako and Yaki and the Time-Attack Circuit
stories.setting: A tidy little go-kart-style circuit
stories.theme: Finishing together beats finishing first
stories.premise: The takoyaki twins enter a friendly, careful time-attack and learn that smooth teamwork and giggles matter more than being fastest.

stories.title: Dai Daruma and the Lucky Dashboard Charm
stories.setting: A workshop restoring a beloved classic car
stories.theme: The luck you feel is the love you put in
stories.premise: Dai Daruma becomes the good-luck charm swinging from the mirror of a lovingly restored classic car, beaming over the friends who fixed it up together.

stories.title: Coro Korokke and the Neighborhood Clean-Up Day
stories.setting: A neighborhood street on community clean-up morning
stories.theme: A clean, kind town is everyone's job
stories.premise: Humble Coro Korokke rallies the cast for a neighborhood tidy-up, and the quiet good deed turns into a joyful, sparkling morning that brings the whole street together.
stories.arc: Arc 14 — Crafts, Games and Cozy Hobbies

stories.title: Niko Nigiri and the Omiyage Souvenir Quest
stories.setting: A train-station souvenir shop full of regional treats
stories.theme: The most thoughtful gift fits the friend, not the list
stories.premise: As the journey nears its end, organized Niko sets out to buy the perfect souvenir treat for each friend, learning that the best gift is one chosen with the heart.

stories.title: Rin Ramen and the Farewell Feast
stories.setting: A big communal table set for a grand farewell dinner
stories.theme: A shared meal holds a whole friendship inside it
stories.premise: Hearty Rin Ramen cooks a giant warm feast for the whole cast before the journey ends, and the steaming, slurpy table becomes a celebration of everything they've shared.

stories.title: Tai Taiyaki and the Last Sunrise by the Sea
stories.setting: A quiet seaside cliff at dawn near the journey's end
stories.theme: Endings are just sunrises in disguise
stories.premise: Brave Tai Taiyaki leads friends to watch one last sunrise over the sea, learning that the end of an adventure is really the bright beginning of the next.

stories.title: Maru Matcha and the Thank-You Tea
stories.setting: A peaceful garden tea gathering to say thanks to everyone
stories.theme: Saying thank you is the warmest goodbye
stories.premise: Calm Maru Matcha hosts a gentle thank-you tea, whisking a cup for each friend and helping the whole cast share what they're most grateful for from the journey.

stories.title: Dai Daruma and the Second Painted Eye
stories.setting: A shrine at journey's end where wishes are completed
stories.theme: You finish a wish by finishing the work
stories.premise: At the journey's close, determined Dai Daruma finally paints in his daruma's second eye, celebrating with friends that the brave wish made long ago has come true.

stories.title: Momo Mochi and the Final Shinkansen Home
stories.setting: The bullet train gliding home past Mount Fuji at golden hour
stories.theme: Home is the people you carry in your heart
stories.premise: Squishy Momo Mochi rides the bullet train home one last time, watching Mount Fuji glow at sunset and realizing the whole journey gave her a hundred new homes-in-the-heart.

stories.title: The Grand Rising-Sun Reunion
stories.setting: A spectacular finale festival beneath Tokyo Tower and Skytree, with fireworks over all of Japan
stories.theme: Every good story circles back to friends and home
stories.premise: The entire kawaii cast gathers for a dazzling grand reunion festival under the Tokyo lights, with onsen steam, lanterns, fireworks, and every friend they made, before a soft and sleepy goodnight to all of Japan.
